Definition
[Set gradient and regular points] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0493, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0494 1. appi:1.30,appi:1.31\group Critical point theory Fix $r(x)=d(x,p)$. Define \[ ( abla _\star r)(x)=\{ V\in T_x\M :|V|=1,\ u+r(\exp _x(-uV))=r(x)\ orall u\in [0,r(x)]\} . \] A point is regular if some unit vector makes angle $<\pi /2$ with every element of $( abla _\star r)(x)$; otherwise it is critical.
